name: Classic Spaghetti Aglio e Olio (Light Olive Oil & Parsley)
whyItWorks: Al dente spaghetti tossed in high-quality extra virgin olive oil with minced Italian parsley and lightly infused garlic oil. It is naturally 100% dairy-free, but olive oil quantity should be moderated if you have fat malabsorption.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for light oil and mild infusion (discard the whole fried garlic pieces and skip red pepper flakes).
